responsibility: System-dependent runtime initialization support centered on signal-to-Ada-exception handling. It defines binder-computed global runtime configuration variables, installs synchronous fault handlers and alternate signal stacks where needed, maps signals such as SIGSEGV/SIGBUS/SIGFPE into predefined Ada exceptions via Raise_From_Signal_Handler, and provides default or target-specific floating-point initialization and context-adjustment hooks. This file is the main startup-side fault and execution-environment initializer, distinct from initialize.c’s user-replaceable pre-elaboration hook and rtinit.c’s runtime reference-counted setup.
